# Pink Trombone

Neil Thapen, MIT license.

Source: https://github.com/evykassirer/pink-trombone
Pinned revision: 84f9e2bf879fcacc3e08df017a1494bfd521f104

Original files retained for provenance (not executed). Adapted oral geometry and two-port scattering are in `src/dsp/tract.js` and `src/dsp/waveguide.js`. The speech glottis and nasal branch are not used: brass playing assumes an open glottis and sealed velum.
